name: app.hellohop/hellohop
description: Read WhatsApp chats and groups, and send messages when allowed, through the HelloHop API.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_CHANNEL_ID
environmentVariables.description: The channel ID the token belongs to.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to enable the send tools. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.hellohop.app/v1.
